payload.title: Getting-started book PDF links return 404 (Learning-Tactus, Programming-Tactus, Tactus-in-a-Nutshell)
payload.description:
**Problem**
The three book "PDF" links on https://tactus.anth.us/getting-started/ 404.

**Evidence**
src/content/books.js:12, :21, :30. Re-checked 2026-10-20, all 404: https://anthusai.github.io/Learning-Tactus/pdf/Learning-Tactus.pdf, https://anthusai.github.io/Programming-Tactus/pdf/Programming-Tactus.pdf, https://anthusai.github.io/Tactus-in-a-Nutshell/pdf/Tactus-in-a-Nutshell.pdf.

**Fix**
Build and publish the PDFs in the book repos' Pages deploys, or drop the `pdf` entries until they exist.

**How to verify**
`curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' <each pdf URL>` returns 200.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
